title: The Watercolor Sky on the Card
youtube_title: The Watercolor Sky on the Card | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Yuri wants to check on a watercolor sky washing across a card before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Yuri leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
